source.notes: FY 2025-26 General Fund net revenue — actual close-out total ($48.93B, 5.4% / $2.52B above FY 2024-25) from IFO's June 2026 Revenue Update. Per-category split is proportionally scaled from the prior approximated mix (original proportions carried forward; exact category-level actuals not yet sourced). Verify exact per-category dollars against IFO's detailed FY 2025-26 close-out before any public launch.

sources.label: Personal Income Tax
sources.shortDescription: PA's flat 3.07% tax on wages and most income — paid by working Pennsylvanians and retirees with taxable income

sources.label: Sales and Use Tax
sources.shortDescription: 6% on most retail purchases (with exemptions for groceries, clothing, and prescriptions)

sources.label: Corporate Net Income Tax
sources.shortDescription: Tax on corporate profits — rate is being phased down to 4.99% by 2031

sources.label: Other Taxes
sources.shortDescription: Cigarette, liquor, gross receipts, inheritance, realty transfer, and other tax revenues

sources.label: Non-Tax Revenue
sources.shortDescription: Licenses, fees, fines, and treasury earnings that enter the General Fund. Most PA non-tax revenue isn't here — gas tax, lottery, and dozens of dedicated fees feed restricted funds outside the General Fund.
